target: self.root / human-surface Frank v0.1 on accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS
headline: ClayCode executes. decide_effect runs from claycode/frank_effects.clay and matches the Python policy reference on 200,576 sampled requests with zero mismatches. Measured corpus coverage of the surface is 7.5 %.

executed.dependency: lark==1.3.1 (pinned; the evaluator depends on this release's LALR/contextual-lexer behaviour)

discriminating_power_demonstrated.note: A green gate is worthless until shown able to go red. The .clay source was sabotaged and restored.

wp04_call_target_partition.cross_validation: matches the supervisor count from an independent implementation
wp04_call_target_partition.undeclared_types_note: Used as return types and constructed positionally, but declared in no .clay source anywhere in claycode/. No host binding can resolve them. Pooling them with the intrinsics hid work belonging to a different owner.
wp04_call_target_partition.decide_effect_note: Calls only destructive_guard_complete, which calls nothing. The most-quoted policy in the program was executable all along and only lacked an evaluator.

measured_roadmap.rescoping_note: The structured frontend TARGET_VPS_PASS is a real pass over 7.5 % of the corpus, not over ClayCode.
measured_roadmap.method_note: No construct's meaning was guessed. An unparsed source is reported as unparsed, honouring the grammar's own law that new syntax requires a new version and unknown constructs fail closed.

recommended_next_steps: Declare EffectReceipt, VerifiedEffectReceipt and DoneReceipt in ClayCode — cheapest item on the work package; unblocks execute, verify_effect and finish.
Bind the 4 pure intrinsics, then extend the differential gate to effect_request_hash and confirmation_matches without touching authority.
Extend the surface by the 13 constructs, highest frequency first, each with a corpus-coverage delta so F-V01-02 progress becomes a measured percentage.
Let target_vps_probe.py call the evaluator instead of its substring check, so its evidence_class can honestly say EXECUTABLE. Closes audit finding A2 at the source.
Restore or vendor claycode_base_frontend.py into the Frank repo, or drop the workflow step asserting a file the repo does not contain.
scope_limits: Only decide_effect and destructive_guard_complete are executed. Nothing is claimed about the other 13 functions in the module.
The evaluator is a tree-walking interpreter, not a compiler. Sufficient for differential semantic evidence and for running policy; not a performance substrate.

ClayCode is not finished. This closes the execution gap on the critical path and replaces an estimate with a measured construct list; type/effect checking, lowering, runtime/FFI, stdlib and concurrency remain open.
Delivered as an open pull request. Disposition belongs to Clay and the project owner.
